name: Boss On-Hit Advancement

system.description:
This effect makes it so that Bosses gain Action Advancement whenever they are hit, it scales with the amount of speed stages it has; providing no benefit if the boss is at 2 or more positive stages, and the most at -6 speed.

Action Advancement% = 5 + clamp(-3 * speedStage, -5, 18)
